What Tom may be asking you to do

A cautious interpretation of the fragments—not a confirmed project specification.

Important: confirm this framing with Tom before treating it as the assignment.
1

Choose validation problems

Use a problem with a known solution when possible to measure convergence, then use decaying supersonic turbulence as the application-like test.

2

Compare Dedner GLM with CT

Hold reconstruction, Riemann solver, precision, initial conditions, and timestep policy fixed so divergence control is the meaningful difference.

3

Optimize for the target GPU

Measure registers, occupancy, shared memory, and throughput. These MHD kernels may be compute- or register-bound rather than limited by memory bandwidth.

4

Report cost per accuracy

Compare wall time needed to reach a fixed error or a fixed-quality scientific observable—not just raw cell updates per second.

Why bremsstrahlung appeared in the notes

Thermal bremsstrahlung emissivity is approximately weighted by density squared:

εff ∝ ne ni T1/2 ≈ ρ² T1/2

That makes it a sensitive synthetic observable: small errors in dense structures can create larger errors in predicted emission.
